# Likavcan.cz

> Professional identity website for Lukáš Likavčan and Peter Likavčan. The site provides stable person identifiers, professional profiles, academic references and selected publications.

## Entity relationship
Bezpečná elektrika is a separate professional project founded by Lukáš Likavčan. It is not a sameAs identity for the person. Regulated E2A inspection services are described as being in preparation.
